name.value: McArthur Island Sport and Event Centre

description.value: McArthur Island Sport and Event Centre is a City of Kamloops municipal facility situated on McArthur Island in the Thompson River, primarily serving lacrosse and multi-sport events. The island setting is accessible via a short bridge and sits within a larger park complex that is popular with walkers and cyclists riding the river trail network. As a public facility it may offer services useful to touring cyclists passing through Kamloops, though specific amenities are unconfirmed.
